footer.disclaimer: This site compiles publicly available information about infrastructure projects in Bengaluru. Every figure is shown with its source and the date it was recorded. An allocation is not evidence that money was spent, and a delay is not evidence of wrongdoing. We do not allege misconduct by any individual, official, department or contractor.
footer.cadence: Updated quarterly, in January, April, July and October. Next sweep due {date}. Each project also shows the date it was last checked.

map.title: Map
map.intro: Projects drawn where they are, coloured by status. Click a project for its figures, or click anywhere (or use your location) to see which ward you are in and what is being built there.
map.coverage: {mapped} of {total} projects are on the map so far. The rest are in the {table_link}; lines are added as their routes are sourced.
map.coverage_none: No project has a mapped line or location yet, so this map currently shows ward boundaries only. Every project is in the {table_link}; lines are added as their routes are sourced.
map.locate_error: Couldn’t get your location. You can click the map instead.
map.privacy: Your location is used only in this browser to find your ward. It is never sent anywhere.
map.basemap_down: The background map couldn’t load, so only project lines and ward boundaries are shown.
map.panel_hint: Click a project or anywhere on the map.
map.gba_pending: Current GBA ward boundaries aren’t available yet; these are the most recent BBMP wards.
map.outside_wards: That point is outside the BBMP ward boundaries.
map.ward_no_projects: No tracked project is mapped to this ward yet.
map.noscript: The map needs JavaScript. Every project is also listed in the project table.
